source.mainFunction:
1) 비타민C : 결합조직 형성과 기능유지에 필요, 철의 흡수에 필요, 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요.
2) 비타민D : 칼슘과 인이 흡수되고 이용되는데 필요, 뼈의 형성과 유지에 필요, 골다공증발생 위험 감소에 도움을 줌.
3) 판토텐산 : 지방, 탄수화물, 단백질 대사와 에너지 생성에 필요.
4) 엽산 : 세포와 혈액생성에 필요, 태아 신경관의 정상 발달에 필요, 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요.
5) 비오틴 : 지방, 탄수화물, 단백질 대사와 에너지 생성에 필요.
6) 마그네슘 : 에너지 이용에 필요, 신경과 근육 기능 유지에 필요.
7) 아연 : 정상적인 면역기능에 필요, 정상적인 세포분열에 필요.
8) 셀렌 : 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요.

8) 아연 : 표시량(2.55mg/6g)의 80~150%

섭취 전 제품에 이상이 있는 경우 섭취를 금하십시오.

drafts.en:
Health Functional FoodMagnesium 94.5mgBiotin 300μgVitamin C 500mgVitamin D 10μgSelenium 50μgZinc 2.55mgFolate 340μgPantothenic acid 100mgOnce a day

블루 이뮨 올인원 밸런스 리포좀비타민CMagnesium · Biotin · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by 코스맥스바이오(주) · Once a day · 1 sachet

This product combines 94.5mg of Magnesium, 300μg of Biotin, 500mg of Vitamin C, 10μg of Vitamin D, 50μg of Selenium, 2.55mg of Zinc, 340μg of Folate, 100mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 sachet): 94.5mg Magnesium, 300μg Biotin, 500mg Vitamin C, 10μg Vitamin D, 50μg Selenium, 2.55mg Zinc, 340μg Folate, 100mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 코스맥스바이오(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Magnesium
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 sachet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Magnesium labelled (94.5mg / 6g), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (300μg / 6g), 80~180%
Vitamin C labelled (500mg / 6g), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (10μg / 6g), 80~180%
Selenium labelled (50μg / 6g), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (2.55mg / 6g), 80~150%
Folate labelled (340μg / 6g), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (100mg / 6g), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 흰 청록색의 분말
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 2년
Storage 수분 및 열에 의해 영향을 받을 수 있으므로 직사광선을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오. 어린이 손에 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Magnesium · Biotin · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
